thread:
nina: Heads up — Pilot customer Foxtrot wants onprem with our keystore proxy + HSM attestation. Requirements: decrypt-only, 1 year audit retention, signed audit ledger, and strict egress (SIEM + attestor only). Can we commit?

alex: Yes for decrypt-only. We'll make the service principal scoped to `keystore:decrypt` + `keystore:status` only. No create/delete perms, and bindings will be time-limited.

priya: Netpols: we'll publish both FQDNs and IP/ASN ranges for customers who need IP allowlists. Recommend client-side pinned TLS fingerprints for the proxy. Also will provide a minimal Kubernetes NetworkPolicy example in the ticket.

nina: Audit: customer demands tamper-evident logs. Proposal: HMAC-per-event with a rolling SHA256 chain, and automated WORM snapshot export on key rotation or suspected compromise. Retention 1 year.

sec-bot: policy-scan ✔ Found `svcadmin` role used broadly. Recommendation: split into least-priv roles (`deploy:runner`, `keystore:decrypt`, `audit:writer`) and require MFA for rotation grants.

ops-bot: Ticket TKT-8102 created: "Foxtrot onprem: keystore proxy + HSM attestation + signed-audit + egress allowlist". Assignee: alex. Notes: tune conntrack for persistent KV cache streams; NAT timeouts can cause mid-request failures.

alex: I'll open the PR today to add the `keystore:decrypt` role and example binding. Will include automation hooks for disabling the proxy principal.

priya: Posting netpol snippet and IP ranges into the ticket shortly. Minimal example will only allow egress to SIEM and the attestation verifier.

nina: Incident runbook (brief): disable proxy principal, snapshot audit ledger to WORM, rotate audit wrap key, notify compliance & customer within 1 hour. Add automation where possible.

alex: Ack. I'll add playbook steps and a signed-snapshot endpoint to the keystore service.

nina: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread.
